# WannierNLQG Tutorials v1.1.0

This release extends the GeS tutorial collection with second-harmonic-generation examples and Fe orbital-magnetization and linear-response examples.

## Highlights

- Second-harmonic-generation examples.
- Fe orbital-magnetization and linear-response results and figures.
- A separately distributed Fe operator bundle.

## Getting started

Use the tutorial source associated with the `v1.1.0` tag. For the Fe full-operator examples, download `Fe_full_operators_v1.1.0_rerun.tar.gz` from this release and install it from the tutorial repository root:

```bash
bash scripts/install_fe_bundle.sh /path/to/Fe_full_operators_v1.1.0_rerun.tar.gz
```

The installer verifies the archive and extracted-file checksums and does not overwrite an existing bundle.

## Notes on the examples

The Fe Wannierization did not meet its convergence criterion, and the Fe examples retain their original diagnostic qualification. The 14 Fe reference results were not recomputed with the final v1.1.0 source; their calculation provenance remains documented separately.

The recorded checks covered 12 smoke groups, 46 reference summaries, and 40 smoke summaries. Six optional GeS spin cases were skipped because the optional data were unavailable.

See the tagged data manifest and checksums for the full provenance and verification records.

## Provenance and checksums

Use the tagged [Fe data manifest](https://github.com/ZhuochengLu/WannierNLQG-tutorials/blob/v1.1.0/Materials/Fe/vasp_SOC/DATA_MANIFEST.json), [validation record](https://github.com/ZhuochengLu/WannierNLQG-tutorials/blob/v1.1.0/VALIDATION.md), and [repository checksums](https://github.com/ZhuochengLu/WannierNLQG-tutorials/blob/v1.1.0/manifests/SHA256SUMS). The exact original qualification, source and model identities, and asset checksums are retained below.

# WannierNLQG tutorials v1.1.0

This release adds second-harmonic-generation examples and Fe OAM/linear-response diagnostic examples to the GeS tutorial collection. The full local smoke passed all 12 groups; result validation passed 46 reference summaries and 40 smoke summaries. Six optional GeS spin cases lack optional data and remain `SKIPPED_MISSING_OPTIONAL_DATA`.

**Fe qualification:** `MAX_ITERATIONS / DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY / Physics HOLD / Production NOT_ELIGIBLE`. The 14 Fe reference responses and figures retain their recorded historical source-tree identity `0c3c61a489d05decfa02544e65e7a3103aed703234ab45efda134a61e6674523`; they were not recomputed under the final v1.1.0 source tree. They share Fe TB SHA-256 `5e19a8258741f4c4555bb47d2dedc597673972f4f1faf683c44c1ce034949714` and full HDF5 bundle SHA-256 `8afdfc64742feb920a3ebc4f49fbd571c3f91fd5a111e588db02ed9676fc0115`. New smoke runs used source tree `3b21d5ef5ef6885e45fa5189ce854f1c12823af373068e9179ed21508dc74a3c`; the released source tree differs only in the frozen test fixture and source manifests, with runtime source files byte-identical. The published Fe `POSCAR` removes one trailing tab without changing numerical tokens; `DATA_MANIFEST.json` records its SHA-256 `d6b050709fb21f6166c179a64f437c724446191ca4f3f9297be11ff007c9c410`, while the frozen VASP input and historical band receipt retain their original hash.

The optional `Fe_full_operators_v1.1.0_rerun.tar.gz` asset is distributed separately from Git (279,428,707 bytes; SHA-256 `d3384745c0a41ee8a9336c0ad9c8dc0ce4796a4bc6e3f35599eb1e3fe41be2b9`). It contains only `Fe_fixed_full.h5` (319,169,364 bytes; SHA-256 `8afdfc64742feb920a3ebc4f49fbd571c3f91fd5a111e588db02ed9676fc0115`). Install from the tutorial repository root with `bash scripts/install_fe_bundle.sh /path/to/Fe_full_operators_v1.1.0_rerun.tar.gz`. The installer verifies both hashes and refuses to overwrite an existing bundle. Publication does not confer Fe physical or production qualification.
